proTipContent: Click the microphone recorder, speak naturally about any project launch, weekly retrospective, or study notes, and watch Gemini build structured action items instantaneously below!
systemSettingsSub: Configure your credentials, model versions, and simulation preferences safely.
apiKeyPlaceholder: Paste your Gemini AI key here (ex. AIzaSy...)
apiKeyFooter: Secure Local Equivalent (Keychain Mock): Key is held locally on your browser. Leaving it empty will default to the NoteWave free system key (rate-limited to 3 requests/day).
tierFooter: Standard Free Tier limits use to 3 requests per day. Upgrades unlock maximum model capabilities and unlimited recordings.
languageFooter: Changes the language of the application.
searchPlaceholderAll: Search transcripts, app names, insights, tags...
searchPlaceholderIdeas: Search codebases, generated app names, tags...
noNotesDesc: Record some voice outlines on the Dictate tab to generate automatic tasks!
noIdeasDesc: Speak about building a software utility, a hardware project, or mobile app features. Gemini will automatically place them here.
noRemindersDesc: Dictate personal reminders, chores, or dates (e.g. 'remind me to review blueprints tomorrow on Saturday at 10 AM') to populate your scheduled agenda.
noTasksDesc: No matching tasks currently display. Click "Add Task" at the top to initialize standalone agenda items!
noThoughtsDesc: Record high-fidelity voice notes or type custom standalone writeups down inside Notes & Ideas!
recordingMicTipSpeak: Speak clearly to dictate your brainstorm ideas! Speak up to 10 minutes about your software/hardware concept, application layouts, chore, or calendar reminder.
recordingMicTipIdle: Press the recording mic below to start. Speak clearly to dictate your brainstorm ideas!
recordingActive: Listening... Press button to Stop Recording
recordingProcessing: Transcribing and synthesizing roadmap via Gemini...
ideaGenDesc: Stuck on what to invent next? Shuffle instant prompts to spark your next big app, SaaS, or electronic hardware masterpiece!
noteAdded: Note added — enhancing it with AI...
manageTasks: Manage your to-dos and track progress
taskTitlePlaceholder: Ex. Wash the car or prepare proposal draft
aiAgentSubtitle: Query and retrieve details from your entire task base and design ideas.
aiAgentPlaceholder: Ask the agent anything about your workspace notes & tasks...
aiAgentRateLimit: Each query consumes 1 prompt request. Free Mode: 3/day. Premium Mode: 50/day.
aiAgentNoMessages: Start chat! Ask a question or click a suggestion below to search through your workspace.
aiAgentCustomKey: You are using your personal API key configured in Settings.
processTextsDesc: Import meeting transcripts, Zoom logs, notes, or files. We will process and index them to build structured summaries, custom action items, and reliable RAG database search structures.
dragDropFile: Drag & drop a text file here, or click to browse
pasteTranscript: Paste your transcript logs, Slack items, daily ideas drafts, or plans here...
emailDigestDesc: Weekly summary of your voice memos and action steps
weeklyDigestDesc: Every Monday, a summarized action-item briefing of your transcripts will be delivered to:
passwordUpdateMsg: Password update simulator activated! We have dispatched a security reset email token.
generateTodosDesc: Generate action checklists from notes and ideas automatically
quotaPolicyDesc: Every artificial intelligence transaction consumes exactly 1 unit of your daily prompt allowance. This encompasses recording one live voice dictation, uploading/indexing one text log document, or posting a query prompt to the Workspace AI Agent.
freePlanLimitsDesc: The free plan allows up to 10 combined notes & uploads and 50 MB of storage. Upgrade to Pro for 100 notes and 1 GB of secure cloud storage.
proUnlockedDesc: Pro-capacity storage is operational. You have unlimited transcribed notes, custom Checklist roadmap generations, and 1 GB secure Cloud Database storage enabled.
dangerZoneDesc: Permanently delete all your data. This action cannot be undone.
deleteConfirmDesc: You are about to permanently erase all your application data. This will completely wipe the following items stored both locally and in the cloud:
deleteFinalWarning: This action is final and cannot be undone! Cloud backups and local database caches cannot recover your records, voice memos, or uploaded files once cleared.
localStorageDefault: NoteWave uses local browser database storage by default. Log in to sync to secure Supabase.
goToLanding: Go to Landing Page to authenticate
importInfo: Import text documents and transcripts from other apps (e.g., Teams/Zoom log briefings). Gemini will categorize, name, and generate custom Checklist Roadmap templates automatically!
recordingTooShort: Recording was too short. Please speak clearly to summarize notes.
micAccessFailed: Could not access microphone. Please allow key permissions in your browser or iframe.
storageFullPremium: Audio storage is full. Delete some voice memos to free up space.
storageFullFree: Audio storage full on the free plan. Delete some memos or upgrade to Pro for more space.
modelsUnavailable: AI models aren't reachable right now. Please wait a few seconds and try again.
invalidApiKey: Invalid API key configured. Please double check your personal credentials in Settings.
transcriptionFailed: Unable to transcribe notes. Please try again.
serverTimeout: Server Connection timeout. Please try again.
networkError: Network error - CORS or connection blocked. Check that the backend server is running and allows requests from your domain.
networkErrorConnect: Network error - failed to connect to the transcription server.
pleasePasteText: Please paste some transcript text or drop a file first.
fileTypeUnsupported: Only text or markdown files (.txt, .md, .csv) are supported for transcription analysis.
couldNotReadFile: Could not read uploaded file content.
imageTooLarge: The image file is too large. Please select a file smaller than 2MB.
